sources.scope: Chapter 16: task, log-mel framing, encoder–decoder, CTC and transducer overview, word edit distance.
The Algorithm: collapse, loss and forward lattice, repeated and distinct labels, greedy and prefix beam search.
Article's explicit CC BY 4.0 grant for the two copied diagrams.
Section 3: path probability and conditional independence.
Sections 2–3: waveform features, masked contrastive learning, supervised CTC.
Section 2: original transducer, blank and label transitions, terminal blank.
Sections 2–3 and Figure 1: joiner, path sums, durations and comparative alignment.
Sections 2.1–2.3, 3.2 and A.1; Figure 1: features, labels, task and timestamp tokens, WER normalization, offline long-form inference.
CC BY 4.0 PMLR publication agreement; captions link to the original papers.
